title: Chick wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#FFD93B'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='19' fill='#FFE45C'/>

  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#F5B82E'/>

  <path d='M38 28 L50 2 L62 28 Z' fill='#4AC7F0'/>

  <path d='M44 14 L56 14' stroke='#FFD93B' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='3.5' r='4' fill='#FF5F9E'/>
  <path d='M38 28 Q50 32 62 28' stroke='#2AA0C9' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
</svg>
